temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. When Maria offers help, Cheryl accepts enthusiastically.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria does not yet have a specific belief that Cheryl is currently overwhelmed; she sees Cheryl as a colleague who may be handling the project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns that Cheryl is stressed and overwhelmed, and that Cheryl is receptive to Maria's assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is currently overwhelmed by the project but open to and appreciative of Maria's help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, compassion, and willingness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes that Cheryl is handling responsibilities better and showing growing confidence. During a staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl for a leadership role; the team leader responds positively and Cheryl accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl was previously overwhelmed but has received help; she may not yet be certain that Cheryl is ready for formal leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's observation of Cheryl's improvement and confidence, followed by Cheryl's acceptance of the leadership role, confirms Cheryl's readiness and willingness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and ready to take on a leadership role; Maria's confidence in her is well placed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl as she takes on the leadership role for the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to check that her leadership suggestion did not feel overstepping or pressuring. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl is ready for leadership and accepted the role, but she is uncertain whether her suggestion may have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's worry is resolved because Cheryl valued Maria's support and did not indicate hard feelings or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl appreciates Maria's support and confidence; Maria's suggestion was received positively despite Cheryl's initial surprise.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry shifting to relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a supportive relationship with Cheryl and ensure Cheryl continues to feel supported rather than pressured.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private conversation, Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support. Maria proposes that they co-lead the project together. Cheryl agrees enthusiastically and says Maria's guidance is invaluable and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciated her support and honesty, and she hopes they can continue collaborating in a way that feels mutually supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms that she wants to co-lead and values Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can co-lead the project effectively and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other collaboratively.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. Maria discusses future projects, and Cheryl says she would love to work together again, calling the experience wonderful and expressing excitement about what they can achieve.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has strengthened; she is hopeful about continuing to work together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, and it is reinforced; Cheryl confirms she wants to team up for more projects and shares Maria's enthusiasm.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl have a strong, successful partnership with mutual interest in future collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue collaborating with Cheryl on future projects.
